newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: South American port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: South American port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ARGENTINA, April 29 - Santa Fe - No vessels berthed, in roads, due. Max. draft 22 ft. 8 in. at access channel. Diamante - One vessel in roads, 1 due. Max. draft 23 ft. 8 in at passage KM 520. San Lorenzo - Five vessels berthed of which 1 loading sbmp, 1 loading soy, 2 loading maize, 1 loading sbm. 4 Vessels in roads, 30 due at 6 terminals during week. Forecast indicates draft will fall about 0.20 metres next week. Pasa berth - Draft 20 ft 4 in fw.

Rosario - Eight vessels berthed of which 2 awaiting orders, 2 discharging fertiliser, 1 loading fruit, 1 loading sbo, 2 loading maize. 3 In roads, 13 due. Forecast indicates draft will fall about 0.20 metres during week. Villa Constitucion - One vessel discharging iron ore. No vessels in roads. Elevator berths - Max. draft 22 ft. fw. San Nicolas - Two vessels berthed of which 1 discharging coal, 1 discharging iron ore. 8 Vessels due. Forecast indicates draft will fall about 0.20 metres in week.

San Pedro - Vessel grounded at access channel at Alvear passage on 26/4 early morning, completely obstructing navigation up/down stream. On 29/4 at 1230 hours vessel was refloated with assistance of a tug and is anchored close to general Lagos terminal. The coastguard only authorises the crossing of the area for vessels with a max draft of 26 ft/fw until soundings are carried out. One vessel in roads, 1 due. Forecast draft will fall about 0.20 metres in week. San Nicolas, San Pedro - Max draft 32 ft 8 in/fw at high tide.

Buenos Aires - 18 vessels in port, 25 due during week. Max. draft 31 ft. 6 in. fw. High tide NAABSA (guided by entrance channel). Dock sud max draft 28/29 ft. fw. high tide NAABSA. Necochea - Five vessels berthed of which 1 loading wheat, 1 loading maize, 1 loading sbmp, 2 discharging dap, 2 loading fish. 1 vessel in roads, 12 due. Max draft at entrance channel 40 ft bw. Bahia Blanca - Five vessels berthed of which 2 loading maize, 1 loading naphtha, 1 loading sfp, 1 loading lpg. 14 due. Draft depends on each berth.

BRAZIL, April 29 - Vitoria - Vessels berthed, 1 general cargo/container discharger/loader, 1 pig iron loader, 2 bulk malt dischargers, 2 tubes loaders, 1 cellulose loader, 1 granite loader. Tubarao - 2 Iron ore loaders. Praia Mole - 3 Steel product loaders, 1 coal discharger. Portocel - 2 Cellulose loaders. Ubu - 1 Iron ore loader. 20 Vessels waiting in roads. Santos - Vessels berthed, 7 full containers, 1 bulk cement, 2 containers, 2 wheat dischargers, 1 container loader, 1 general cargo/container loader/discharger, 1 general cargo loader, 2 general cargo dischargers, 2 bulk soy, 1 vehicles, 1 chemical products, 2 diesel loaders, 1 sugar loader, 1 salt discharger, 1 container/ro-ro. 9 Vessels waiting in roads, 76 due in next 7 days.

Private terminals - Cosipa - 1 Bulk coal, 1 iron ore, 1 steel products. Ultrafertil - 1 Fertiliser discharger. Paranagua - Vessels berthed, 1 container discharger, 1 general cargo, 1 reefer, 3 pellets loaders, 1 general cargo, 2 soy. 17 Vessels waiting in roads of which 10 pellets loaders, 7 soya loaders. 33 Due in next 7 days. Rio Grande - Vessels berthed, 4 container loaders, 1 soybeans, 2 soy, 1 general cargo, 1 fertiliser, 1 petroleum. Vessel waiting in roads, 22 due in next 10 days. Rio de Janeiro - Vessels berthed, 3 general cargo/containers, 3 wheat dischargers, 1 automobiles discharger, 2 general cargo, 2 steel products/general cargo, 3 naval. 3 Vessels at Tecon, 22 due. Sao Sebastiao - Three vessels berthed at Tebar, 1 at commercial quay, 2 waiting in roads, 9 due in next 7 days.

CHILE, April 28 - Arica - Two vessels in terminal, 4 berths vacant, 11 vessels due. Iquique - Two vessels berthed working normally, 4 berths vacant, 11 vessels due. Antofagasta - Three vessels berthed, 4 berths vacant. 7 Vessels due during the week for loading and discharging concentrates, bulk copper, containers and general cargo. Valparaiso - Three vessels berthed working normally, 6 berths vacant. 27 Vessels due during the week, 1 days delay expected. San Antonio - Four vessels operating, 7 berths vacant. 14 Vessels due during the week, port busy, but no waiting time.

Conception Bay ports - Talcahuano - Three vessels due, no vessels waiting in roads. San Vicente - Two vessels operating, 1 berth vacant. 10 Vessels due, 1 day berthing delay expected. Navy pier (Molo 500) - 3 Vessels due. Steel pier - 1 Vessel due during the week. Coronel pier - No vessels. Oil terminal - 1 Vessel berthed. Lirquen - Four vessels berthed, 2 berths vacant, 4 vessels due during the week. Puerto Montt - Three vessels in port, 1 passenger vessel, 6 vessels due during the week. Punta Arenas - One vessel berthed, 12 due.

COLOMBIA, April 29 - Barranquilla - One bulker berthed, 1 due, 1 container due, 4 general cargo berthed, 5 due. Cartagena - One bulker due, 4 containers berthed, 12 due. 1 General cargo berthed, 4 due, 1 pcc due, 1 passenger vessel berthed, 2 due. Santa Marta - One bulker berthed, 1 due, 3 containers berthed, 7 due, 2 general cargo berthed, 1 anchored, 6 due.

PERU, April 28 - Callao - Six vessels in bay, 9 in pier (general cargo/containers). No berthing delays. Paita - One fishmeal/general cargo vessel in pier. No delays. Bayovar - One vessel in bay. No berthing delays. Talara - One vessel in bay, 1 in pier (oil), 8 days berthing delay. Chimbote - One fishmeal vessel in bay, no berthing delays. Pisco - No vessels. Ilo - Two vessels in bay, 2 in pier (fishmeal). No delays.

VENEZUELA, April 28 - Puerto Cabello - Three vessels anchored. 10 Vessels berthed of which 6 grain, 2 general cargo, 2 containers. Piers 1 and 2 closed. Guanta - Three vessels anchored. April 29 - Orinoco river - Draft 33 ft. Puerto Ordaz - Two vessels waiting at anchorage to load/discharge. 2 Operating of which 1 discharging manganese ore, 1 loading iron ore. 3 Vessels due. Boca Grande - One vessel due. Palua - Two vessels due. Punta Cuchillo - Two vessels due. Venalum - Two vessels due. Matanzas - Two vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 7 operating of which 5 loading steel products, 2 discharging general cargo.

La Guaira - Four vessels loading/discharging general, 4 due, 3 under repair, 1 passenger vessel. Puerto Cabello - 17 Vessels loading/discharging general, 15 due. Guanta - Four vessels due. Amuay - One vessel waiting at anchorage to load, 4 loading refined products. Cardon - Four loading refined products. Guaranao - One waiting at anchorage, 1 loading/discharging generals. Maracaibo - One vessel due. Buoy B71 - One vessel due. All ports working normally.
